description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator' implementing the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring menu options for editing employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM platform, specifically overriding module and screen identifiers for the 'time' module and 'viewAttendanceRecord' screen.

classes.name: EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures menu items for editing employee attendance records by overriding module and screen context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module to 'time' and screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord' in the menu configuration.
